Simple math: “debt” (largest deficit first)

You have options ii (types, tags, etc.), each with a target percentage wiwi​ (sum to 1).
After you have shown nn cards, you’ve shown option ii exactly cici​ times.

Define debt:

di=wi⋅n−cidi​=wi​⋅n−ci​

Pick the option with the largest debt (most behind its target).

This converges fast because every step fixes the biggest shortfall.

  1. Use debt to pick Type (Items vs Topics).
  2. Within that type, use debt to pick Tag.
